subject: HIPAA/BAA eligibility — follow-up & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medcarehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HIPAA/BAA eligibility — follow-up & next steps

Hi Jordan / MedCare team,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap + next steps from our side: 

1) SOC 2 status: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in late 2028. I can share the redacted report and a read-only link for your security team (attached).

2) BAA availability: Redwood offers a Business Associate Agreement for customers that need to handle PHI, but it is scoped to specific deployment modes. Short answer: Dedicated and Private deployments are eligible for BAA execution; our hosted multi-tenant API is generally not eligible to transmit PHI under a BAA.

3) PHI boundaries / eligible modes: 
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): logical/data isolation with contractual BAA coverage — supports PHI.
- Private (VPC or on-prem): full eligibility for PHI, supports customer-managed KMS and network isolation.
- Hosted API: only for de-identified data or if your legal team accepts residual risk; not covered by our standard BAA.

4) Next steps I promised: attached our initial security questionnaire (MedCare_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) — if you can return the completed sheet we will route to our security and compliance team. I also attached a draft BAA for your legal to review.

Could you confirm which deployment mode you expect to use (Dedicated vs Private) and whether MedCare will plan to transmit PHI into the service or only de-identified outputs? That will let me pull the correct internal folks and draft the BAA scope.

Proposed timeline: we’ll aim to turn around an initial BAA draft + answers to the questionnaire within 3 business days after we receive the completed sheet.

Thanks — cc'ing Neha (legal/procurement lead) and Rishi (solutions/infra) to stay in the loop.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: MedCare_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medcarehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: MedCare Security <security@medcarehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HIPAA/BAA eligibility — follow-up & next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the thorough recap. Quick answers and a couple follow-ups: 

- We do expect to transmit PHI (patient identifiers + clinical notes) as part of the planned workflow, so we will need a BAA and confirmation that PHI is allowed.
- Our preference is to start with Dedicated (reserved capacity) in the cloud region you recommend; depending on procurement timing we may consider Private VPC later.
- Data residency: we need US-only hosting for this workload. Can you confirm Dedicated can be provisioned in us-west-2?

We're starting to fill out the security questionnaire and will return it by EOD Wed. Also attaching the initial risk questions our InfoSec asked (see attached).

One more ask — can you confirm Redwood's SOC 2 report is Type II and what the report period covers? Our team will need a redacted copy or a secure link.

Thanks,
Jordan Price
Head of Integrations | MedCare Health
jordan.price@medcarehealth.com

Attachments: MedCare_initial_risk_questions.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medcarehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HIPAA/BAA eligibility — follow-up & next steps

Jordan — appreciate the quick replies and clear signal on PHI. Answers inline below: 

- SOC 2: yes, Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (report period Jan 1 2028 - Dec 31 2028). I've uploaded a redacted copy and a secure read-only link here: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/soc2/redacted/medcare-access (link attached as SOC2_Redacted_Report_link.txt). If your security team prefers, we can host a brief walkthrough with our compliance manager.

- Dedicated in us-west-2: confirmed — we can provision Dedicated capacity in us-west-2. We'll need a sizing estimate from your side (expected RPS, average and p95 token lengths) to size the reserved pool. Rishi can lead on technical sizing.

- BAA & PHI: confirming again that Dedicated and Private (VPC/on-prem) are eligible for a BAA and allowed to handle PHI. Hosted multi-tenant API is not covered by our standard BAA.

- Next steps: please return the filled questionnaire and the initial risk doc. Once we have those we will: 
  1) Share a scoped BAA (attached draft BAA_draft_v1.pdf).
  2) Provide a Dedicated sizing recommendation and estimated lead time for provisioning.
  3) Set up a short call between MedCare InfoSec and our compliance/infra team if needed.

Let me know if you'd like me to loop in our Compliance Manager (name: Priya Natarajan) for the walkthrough — happy to do that.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: BAA_draft_v1.pdf; SOC2_Redacted_Report_link.txt

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MedCare procurement / next steps (HIPAA BAA)

Marissa / Rishi — quick internal note after Jordan's responses: 

- Jordan confirmed PHI will be transmitted and wants Dedicated in us-west-2. That makes them BAA-eligible.
- I'll own the BAA execution and procurement paperwork once we have the completed questionnaire and any required legal redlines. I'll coordinate with Procurement and Legal for standard timelines (typically 2-3 weeks for enterprise BAA review, faster if we get redlines early).
- Rishi: please prepare an initial Dedicated sizing ask (ops: expected concurrency; app team: token estimates) so we can provide a cost/lead time estimate to MedCare.

I'll draft an email to Jordan with the procurement steps and a DocuSign link for the BAA once we have the final draft.

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa to keep external cadence.

Neha Kapoor
